policy.NER_metric: exact typed-span micro-F1; rejected candidates add no extra primary FP
policy.SA_metric: fixed negative/positive macro-F1, 2x3 confusion with INVALID column
policy.cluster: Unicode NFC + collapsed whitespace of COMPLETE original text
policy.cost_comparison: descriptive measured scopes only; no clean cross-backend ranking

ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.gold: strict original IOB2; at most one gold type per exact boundary
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.inference: descriptive counts only; no new confirmatory tests or confidence intervals
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.input: same accepted predicted spans and original gold as primary typed F1
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.interpretation: output boundary detection and conditional type assignment under the fixed parser, not latent language comprehension
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.missing_spurious: missing/spurious exact boundaries; never greedy overlap or nearest-boundary matching
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.multi_type_prediction: count boundary and distinct typed spans separately; exclude that boundary from type-confusion denominator
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.type_confusion: gold row, predicted column; exact shared boundaries with one predicted type only
ner_boundary_type_descriptive_diagnostic.untyped_match: exact (start,end) endpoint-set equality; types ignored and endpoints deduplicated

policy.seed_summary: mean of three separate metrics; sample SD; no pooled counts or ensemble

ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.alignment_and_merge: unchanged literal whole-token alignment, ontology and all-window ownership merge
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.body: must be valid JSON array under unchanged duplicate-key/nonfinite-constant rejecting parser; any interior triple-backtick sequence rejects unwrapping
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.changes: remove only surrounding fence and outer response whitespace; preserve body bytes and every other generation flag
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.eligibility: completed non-refusal non-runtime-failed response; after outer Unicode str.strip, sole triple-backtick fence; opening/closing delimiter on separate lines
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.inference: descriptive exact typed P/R/F1 only; no new model calls, CI or confirmatory hypothesis
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity to this fixed output wrapper under the same parser; not latent language comprehension
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.language_tag: absent or ASCII json, case-insensitive; only spaces/tabs after opening tag
ner_fence_only_descriptive_sensitivity.scope: descriptive sensitivity only, all four ordinary prompted NER systems
